constraints.definition: CHECK (hasta IS NULL OR hasta >= desde)
CHECK (hasta IS NULL OR hasta >= desde)
CHECK (fin IS NULL OR fin >= inicio)
CHECK (baja IS NULL OR baja >= inicio)

CHECK ((tipo = ANY (ARRAY['DEPOSITO'::text, 'DEVOLUCION'::text])) AND turno_id IS NULL AND movimiento_id IS NOT NULL OR (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['APLICACION'::text, 'REVERSO'::text])) AND turno_id IS NOT NULL AND movimiento_id IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (replacement_id) REFERENCES marathon.movimientos(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
FOREIGN KEY (reversal_id) REFERENCES marathon.movimientos(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CHECK (storage_path IS NOT NULL OR legacy_url IS NOT NULL)
CHECK (cuota_id IS NULL OR origen = 'CAJA'::text AND (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['INGRESO'::text, 'EGRESO'::text])) AND turno_id IS NULL AND bono_id IS NULL AND anticipo_id IS NULL AND operacion_id IS NULL)
CHECK (anticipo_id IS NULL OR origen = 'ANTICIPO'::text AND (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['INGRESO'::text, 'EGRESO'::text])) AND turno_id IS NULL AND bono_id IS NULL AND operacion_id IS NULL)
CHECK (bono_id IS NULL OR origen = 'BONO'::text AND turno_id IS NULL AND operacion_id IS NULL AND (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['INGRESO'::text, 'EGRESO'::text])))
CHECK (compensacion_de IS NULL OR compensacion_de <> id AND length(TRIM(BOTH FROM motivo)) >= 3)

CHECK (subtipo IS NULL OR subtipo = 'SALDO_INGRESO'::text AND origen = 'CAJA'::text AND tipo = 'INGRESO'::text AND dni IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(turno_id, cuota_id, bono_id, anticipo_id, operacion_id) = 0 OR subtipo = 'SALDO_DEVOLUCION'::text AND origen = 'CAJA'::text AND tipo = 'EGRESO'::text AND dni IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls(turno_id, cuota_id, bono_id, anticipo_id, operacion_id) = 0 OR (subtipo = ANY (ARRAY['OTRO_INGRESO'::text, 'GASTO_GENERAL'::text, 'OTRO_EGRESO'::text, 'PAGO_PROFESIONAL'::text])) AND origen = 'CAJA'::text AND dni IS NULL AND num_nonnulls(turno_id, cuota_id, bono_id, anticipo_id, operacion_id) = 0 AND (subtipo = 'OTRO_INGRESO'::text AND tipo = 'INGRESO'::text OR subtipo <> 'OTRO_INGRESO'::text AND tipo = 'EGRESO'::text) AND (subtipo <> 'PAGO_PROFESIONAL'::text OR profesional_asociado_id IS NOT NULL AND terapia_asociada_id IS NOT NULL))

CHECK (num_nonnulls(subtotal, discount_rate, discount_amount) = 0 OR num_nonnulls(subtotal, discount_rate, discount_amount) = 3 AND (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['VENTA'::text, 'ALQUILER'::text])) AND subtotal >= 0::numeric AND discount_rate >= 0::numeric AND discount_rate <= 100::numeric AND discount_amount = round(subtotal * discount_rate / 100::numeric, 2) AND importe_total = (subtotal - discount_amount))
FOREIGN KEY (original_id) REFERENCES marathon.ortopedia_operaciones(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED
CHECK (coberturas IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(coberturas) = 'array'::text AND jsonb_array_length(coberturas) <= 20)
FOREIGN KEY (fuente_id, dni) REFERENCES marathon.saldo_fuentes(id, dni)
FOREIGN KEY (aplicacion_id, fuente_id, dni) REFERENCES marathon.saldo_aplicaciones(id, fuente_id, dni)

CHECK ((tipo = ANY (ARRAY['APLICACION'::text, 'REVERSO_APLICACION'::text])) AND aplicacion_id IS NOT NULL AND movimiento_id IS NULL OR (tipo = ANY (ARRAY['INGRESO'::text, 'DEVOLUCION'::text])) AND aplicacion_id IS NULL AND movimiento_id IS NOT NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (fuente_id, dni) REFERENCES marathon.saldo_fuentes(id, dni)

CHECK (coverage IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(coverage) = 'object'::text AND coverage ? 'type'::text AND ((coverage ->> 'type'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['PARTICULAR'::text, 'OBRA_SOCIAL'::text, 'ART'::text, 'CLUB'::text])))

CHECK (fixed_until IS NULL AND fixed_days IS NULL OR fixed_until IS NOT NULL AND fixed_days IS NOT NULL AND cardinality(fixed_days) >= 1 AND cardinality(fixed_days) <= 7 AND fixed_days <@ ARRAY[0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])
FOREIGN KEY (original_id) REFERENCES marathon.turnos(id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

note: Solo metadatos estructurales, sin registros de pacientes ni credenciales. No es un respaldo ni un instalador completo.
